name: Chuck
def: Cart shaped collaborative robot that leads warehouse pickers along a batched pick path and carries up to about 91 kg of totes.
body: Chuck is a wheeled picking cart that drives itself to each location and cues the associate with lights, a display and voice prompts. Modular shelving gives up to six levels of tote space, and navigation uses lidar and cameras against a site map without floor infrastructure. 6 River Systems was founded in 2015 by former Kiva Systems executives, and Chuck fleets are used in retail, apparel and third party logistics warehouses.
facts: Founded in 2015 by former Kiva Systems executives
Shopify acquired 6 River Systems in 2019 and Ocado took over the business in 2023
Configurations offer up to six shelf levels of workspace
specs: Differential drive cart with modular multi level tote shelving
Map based navigation with batch optimised pick paths and worker prompts
